content.short: MUFEX is a social decentralized trading exchange on Mantle featuring copy trading, smart money tools, and a wide range of perpetual contracts.
content.description: MUFEX is a decentralized derivatives exchange that integrates social trading features with traditional DeFi functionality, allowing traders to follow and automatically copy the strategies of top-performing participants. The platform targets both novice users seeking to learn from experts and experienced traders who need deep liquidity for perpetual contracts. Built on the Mantle Network, MUFEX combines community engagement with professional derivatives trading infrastructure.
